items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: And I mean, we made some money. And you know who was the most honest to work with? Who? May Alex.

ctx.x: And I mean, we made some money. And you know who was the most honest to work with? Who? May Alex. May Alex.
Did she own the place? No. But she sang? So I didn't dance her then. Did she dance to May Alex?
